versions.changelog: Aligned MCP metadata with the current release line and repackaged the canonical skill bundle so GitHub and ClawHub match. Fixed distribution drift where ClawHub 0.18.0 lagged behind the local and GitHub package contents.

Added richer examples and setup guidance across agent runtimes. Changed onboarding to include recommended timezone setup and clearer runtime paths. Fixed timezone-default query guidance to reduce configuration errors.
Updated skill metadata and docs to match current MCP/API capabilities, token-efficient retrieval controls, and onboarding guidance.
Added compact task retrieval (fields/projection, compact modes, description controls) and targeted filters for recurring, priority buckets, and scheduled/start/due selectors.
Added today/upcoming retrieval presets, timezone-aware range filters, and sort controls for token-efficient task queries. Added explicit public-beta onboarding copy for signup + scoped API tokens.

- Updated description and documentation for clarity, emphasizing secure prioritization, tagging, and time block planning.
- Detailed supported operations, including task, tag, and settings management, with explicit API method names.
- Added subtask and time-blocking usage guidance.
- Expanded setup and scope explanation to improve safety and encourage use of scoped API tokens.
- Added safety rules for destructive actions and status management (delete vs. status=done).
- Outlined all available MCP tool endpoints and their intended usage.
Migrated public slug to unitask-agent. Added onboarding setup guidance and compact use-case prompts. Expanded MCP task + tag workflows with secure token metadata.
Outcome-focused positioning, onboarding setup guidance, and expanded MCP task + tag workflows.
